subject.title: fix(extensions): bound JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should this broader response-bounds branch be narrowed to the remaining unsuperseded call sites before merge, or should maintainers pause it in favor of focused per-plugin PRs?
rationale: The fix direction is valid, but current main has already landed overlapping pieces and the remaining compatibility boundary spans message and plugin workflows, so a maintainer should decide the acceptable scope before merge.

options.title: Narrow And Re-Prove
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, remove the landed Tlon scry slice and SDK budget edits, keep only remaining call sites, and post changed-plugin-path proof before review resumes.

options.title: Accept Broader Compatibility Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the 16 MiB fail-closed behavior across the broader branch after the concrete findings are fixed and proof is updated.

options.title: Pause For Focused PRs
options.body: If the branch remains stale or mixed, maintainers can close or pause it and continue landing smaller proof-positive response-bound PRs.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Re-Prove
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, remove the landed Tlon scry slice and SDK budget edits, keep only remaining call sites, and post changed-plugin-path proof before review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the focused Tlon scry fix and already gave item-specific scope guidance on this PR.
